issue.title: Feature request: crash when the config file is empty
issue.body:
Feature request: I would like the tool to stop crashing when the config file is empty.

Steps: `touch config.json && tool run`.

Expected: it starts with defaults, as the documentation says.

Actual: panic with "unexpected end of JSON input" and exit code 2.

Version: 3.4.1. It worked in 3.3.0.
